context: Daichi visits the countryside on a friend's recommendation. He stops at Tatsuya's farm stand and they get talking.
purpose: two regional voices meeting — Kansai brightness against rural country reserve

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: すいません、これ、いくらですか？
lines.en: Excuse me, how much is this?
lines.style: Kansai warm casual customer-cadence, the regional swing audible in the standard inquiry, soft real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.style: Country gruff brief direct delivery, the rural-sales casualness, soft real generosity threading throughout delivery throughout.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: ほな、二つください。関西から来てまして。
lines.en: Then, two please. I came from Kansai.
lines.style: Kansai warm friendly easy disclosure, the regional swing audible, soft real openness threading throughout delivery throughout.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: おう、関西か。遠いとこから。
lines.en: Oh, Kansai. From a long way.
lines.style: Country gruff warm acknowledgment, the rural recognition of distance audible, soft real warmth threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: こういう田舎、わいの故郷思い出すわ。
lines.en: Countryside like this — reminds me of my hometown.
lines.style: Kansai warm nostalgic disclosure, the regional swing softening, soft real warmth threading throughout delivery throughout.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.style: Country gruff genuine surprised curiosity, the rural-recognition broadening, soft real interest threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: もちろん。山ばっかりですわ、わいの実家のあたり。
lines.en: Of course. Mountains all around my parents' place.
lines.style: Kansai warm easy laughing disclosure, the regional swing softening with the memory, soft real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: ほう。田舎は田舎で、ええもんやな。
lines.en: Hmm. Countryside has its goodness, doesn't it.
lines.style: Country gruff warm shared appreciation, the rural-bridge across regions audible, soft real warmth threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: ほんまに。空気が違いますもん。
lines.en: Truly. The air really is different.
lines.style: Kansai warm sincere agreement, the regional swing carrying real appreciation, soft real warmth threading throughout delivery.
